paite: Tu in unaute aw, khalam thilpiak thute na theih louh uh ka ut kei hi.
heading: Khalam Thilpiakte

paite: Zentelte na hih lai un bangchidan peuh a hon pi lai un leng, huai milim pau theiloute lam ah pimang in na om uh chih na thei uhi.
Huaiziak in kuamah in, Pathian Kha a thu gen in, "Jesu hamsiat in om hen," achi ngei kei. Huan kuamah in, Kha Siangthou kia lou ngal in, "Jesu, Toupa ahi," achi ngei kei uh chih ka hon theisak hi.
Huan thilpiak tuamtuam a-om a, Kha bel kikhat ahi.
Nasepna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Toupa khat ahi.
Nasepsakna tuamtuam leng a-om, himahleh Pathian khat ahi, mi tengteng a bangkim sempa ahi.
Himahleh Kha theihsakna michih kiphattuampih chiatna ding in piak ahi.
Mi khat kiang ah Kha in pilna thu apia hi; midang kiang ah, huai Kha mah in theihna thu apia hi.
Huan midang kiang a, huai Kha mah in, ginna apia a; midang kiang ah hihdamtheihna apia;
midang kiang ah thillamdang hihtheihna, midang kiang ah thugenkholh theihna, midang kiang ah khate theihkak theihna, midang kiang ah pau tuamtuamte, midang kiang ah pautuamte hilhchetna.
Himahleh hiaite tengteng Kha khat leh akikhat mah in, michih kiang ah adeih bang zel a hawm in asem hi.
Pumpi i chih khat ahi a, hiang anei a, pumpi hiangte tengteng, tam mah le uh, pumpi khat ahi a; Khrist leng huchibang mah ahi.
heading: Pumpi A Kipan Sin Ding

paite: I vek un pumpi khat a om ding in Kha khat a baptis in i omta ua, Judate hiam, Grikte hiam, sikhate hiam sikha lou hiam; huan i vek un Kha khat a kipan dawnsak in i omta uhi.
Pumpi i chih hiang khat kia hilou in tampi ahi zaw hi.
Khepek in, "Khut ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
Huan bil in, "Mit ka hih louh ziak in pumpi a pang ka hi kei," chileh, huai thu ziak in pumpi a pang lou ahi tuan kei hi.
Pumpi tengteng mit hi vek taleh gingzakna koi ah a-om dia? Avek in gingzakna hitaleh, gimzakna koi ah a-om dia?
Himahleh Pathian in hiang khempeuh pumpi ah a-utna peuh ah a-omsak chiatta hi.
Huchi in huai tengteng hiang khat kia hileh pumpi pen koi ah a-om dia?
Himahleh hiang tampi ahi zaw uh, himahleh pumpi khat kia ahi.
Huan mit in, khut kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei kei; lu in leng khepekte kiang ah, "Bangmah in ka hon deih kei," achi thei sam kei hi.
Huchih nak sang in, pumpi hiang hat dia kilawm lou pente akiphamohzaw mahmah uhi.
Huchi in pumpi hiang pahtawi tham louh zaw a i sehte, huaite ngei i pahtawi zaw uhi; huan i hiang kilawmloute'n kilawmna thupizaw amu zel uhi.
I hiang kilawmte'n bel huchibang a hih akiphamoh kei uhi. Pathian in, kilawmna nei lou hiang pahtawi zawk ding in, pumpi alemkhawm hi.
Huchi a pumpi a kikhenna om lou a, ahiangte'n kibangtak a akibuaipihtuah theih zawkna ding un.
Huchi in hiang khat in athuakleh hiang tengteng in athuakpih a, hiang khat pahtawi a a-omleh hiang dangte'n akipahpih zel uhi.
Huchi in noute Khrist pumpi na hi ua, ahiangte na hi chiat lai uhi.

Huan Pathian in khenkhat saptuam lak ah ahon koih a, akhatna ah sawltakte, anihna ah thugenkholte, athumna ah sinsaktute akoih a; huai nung in thillamdang hihte a-om a; huai nung in hihdamtheihna thilpiakte, panpih theihna thilpiakte, vaihawm siamna thilpiakte, pau tuamtuam a thugentheihna thilpiakte a-om nawn hi.
Avek un sawltak ahi uhia? Avek un thugenkholmi ahi uhia? Avek un sinsaktu ahi uhia?
Avek un thillamdang hihmi ahi uhia? Avek un hihdamtheihna thilpiakte ahi uhia? Avek un pautuamte in thu agen uhia? Avek un thu hilhchianmi ahi uhia?
Thilpiak thupipente lunggulh mahmah zaw un. Huan lampi hoihsem ka hon ensak ding hi.
